title: Exposures Exposed: A Measurement and User Study to Assess Mobile Data Privacy in Context
reasoning: The paper conducts a user study focused on assessing user perceptions of mobile data privacy. A core part of this study involves asking participants to evaluate the 'legitimacy' and 'risk' of various data exposures, classifying them as 'Needed by the App', 'not Harmful', or 'maybe Harmful'. These classifications are ethical judgments about the appropriateness and potential harm of an application's behavior, thereby evaluating users' ethical and moral frameworks regarding data privacy.
